lines.en: Grandma, a bird is singing in the tree!
Yes. It has a nest on that high branch.
lines.ko: 네. 저 높은 가지에 둥지가 있어요.

lines.en: Can I see the baby birds?
Not too close. The mother bird may fly away.
lines.ko: 너무 가까이는 안 돼요. 어미 새가 날아갈 수 있어요.

lines.en: Look! A feather is on the ground.
It's from the bird's wing. Keep it.
What is that insect? It has six legs.
lines.ko: 저 곤충은 뭐예요? 다리가 여섯 개예요.

lines.en: That's an ant. Yesterday I saw many ants here.
lines.ko: 개미예요. 어제 여기서 개미를 많이 봤어요.

lines.en: Will the birds sing again tomorrow morning?
Yes. We will listen together after breakfast.
lines.ko: 네. 아침 먹고 같이 들을 거예요.

lines.en: Hello! Your garden is full of butterflies.
Thank you. They love these purple flowers.
I see bees too. Are the bees safe?
Yes. They are busy. They don't care about us.
Last spring, a bee flew into my kitchen.
lines.ko: 지난봄에 벌 한 마리가 우리 부엌에 들어왔어요.

lines.en: Did it fly out again after that?
Yes, I opened the window. Are those ants?
Yes. Ants and bees are good insects for the garden.
lines.ko: 네. 개미와 벌은 정원에 좋은 곤충이에요.

lines.en: A bird is singing over there. So nice.
It will build a nest here soon. Come see!
lines.ko: 곧 여기에 둥지를 지을 거예요. 보러 오세요!
